title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Renewal Acceptance and the Post-Expiry Grace Period
content:
## Clauses in force

**R1 — Renewal by acceptance.** A business renews a Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement by accepting the offer in the governing commercial gas renewal notice. The contracted annual therms are reset to the site's annual therm usage on the acceptance date.

**R2 — Active agreements only.** A commercial gas renewal is accepted only on an active agreement, as the agreement record shows.

**R3 — Start of the new term.** When the acceptance is made on or before the contract end date, the new term starts the day after the contract end date; after a rollover, it starts on the acceptance date.

**R4 — Post-expiry grace period.** When the commercial gas agreement has already rolled over, a renewal acceptance is honoured only when the business accepts no later than the plan's post-expiry renewal grace period, in calendar days, after the rollover took effect on the plan change date. Day one is the calendar day after the plan change date, and the grace period closes at the end of the calendar day equal to the plan change date plus the grace days. The last day is inside the grace period. The plan change date is read from the agreement record.

## Withdrawn wording

The following wording of this policy is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis and may not be applied:

- *Withdrawn:* that on renewal "the agreement takes the offered plan, its term and the offered price".
- *Withdrawn:* "Each renewal earns one renewal loyalty credit equal to the renewal loyalty credit of the plan renewed into."

## R4 boundary dates (hypothetical plan change date 2026-01-01, with the 15-day grace period of the plan schedule)

| Acceptance date | Day of the grace period | Honoured under R4? |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-01-02 | Day 1 | Yes |
| 2026-01-16 | Day 15, the last day | Yes |
| 2026-01-17 | Day 16 | No |

## R3 in table form

| When the business accepts | First day of the new term |
|---|---|
| On or before the contract end date | The day after the contract end date |
| After the agreement has rolled over, within the grace period | The acceptance date |

## Basis question

**Is a renewal accepted on an agreement that is drop pending?** No. Under R2 a renewal is accepted only on an active agreement.
